selections.description: Keep upstream's iOS app working after SideStore re-signs it under the installer's own Apple team.
acceptance: scripts/patch-upstream.sh applies to the new upstream checkout and all of its own checks pass.
Every App Group or bundle identifier that the app or its extensions hardcode resolves at runtime, because SideStore renames App Groups to <group>.<TEAMID> and appends the team ID to bundle IDs.
App Group lookups go through SideloadAppGroup.resolve(fallback:), which reads the group from the embedded provisioning profile.
Each patch still stops the build with a clear message when the upstream code it targets is missing, instead of silently doing nothing.

instructions.goal: When upstream changes the code the sideload patch targets, or adds new team-specific identifiers, update the patch so the app builds and its keyboard can still reach the app after SideStore re-signs it.
adaptation: Patch the upstream checkout at build time with small, targeted substitutions in scripts/patch-upstream.sh.
Match on the identifier being replaced rather than whole lines, so unrelated upstream edits don't break the patch.
Derive extension bundle IDs from Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier instead of hardcoding them.
nonGoals: Do not copy upstream source files into this repository.
Do not remove, disable, or stub out upstream features to make the build pass.
Do not change how releases, versions, or source.json are produced.

preserve: The .ipa stays unsigned for distribution: built with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO, then ad-hoc signed with upstream's entitlements by scripts/build-ipa.sh.
Upstream bundle IDs stay unchanged in the .ipa; SideStore appends the installer's team ID itself.
scripts/patch-upstream.sh stays idempotent and exits non-zero when a patch cannot be applied.
